title: Carbon monoxide catalytic oxidation catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a carbon monoxide catalytic oxidation catalyst as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, adding acopper source and a cerium source into a solvent, and performing uniform stirring and mixing to obtain a precursor solution; and transferring the precursor solution into a reaction kettle, performingsealing and heating for solvothermal reaction, and sequentially filtering, washing, drying and calcining the obtained reaction product mixed solution to obtain the CuO-CeO2 catalyst. Compared with the prior art, the CuO-CeO2 catalyst is prepared by adopting a one-step solvothermal method, and the obtained catalyst product has the advantages of high purity, good uniformity and the like, shows relatively high catalytic activity and good catalytic stability in a carbon monoxide catalytic oxidation reaction, and has a relatively good industrial application prospect.
